label: the bottom lane under Android's gesture bar — every bottom-anchored control clears the bar by the gutter; iOS untouched
notes: Wil, 2026-09-22, four Pixel 6 (Chrome) screenshots: the splash CTA, the 1858 lens's door, the Bakery hero title and the museum rail all crowd the gesture-navigation pill. Measured from the shots (1080x2400 at 2.625): Chrome draws the page to the screen's edge and reports the 24px gesture bar as env(safe-area-inset-bottom); --ui-inset's max(20, 24) stands every bottom control's box ON the bar's top edge (the door's box at 24.0px from the edge, the counter's ink at 28.6, the hero's ink at 23.2 on the raw gutter, the splash frame's border at 10.7 under the pill; the pill's top at 13.7). Fix: a bottom lane, --ui-inset-b = max(--ui-inset, gutter + reported bottom inset), and --gesture-bar, defined only under `@supports not (-webkit-touch-callout: none)` — the inverse of every iOS gate — so iOS and every engine with no reported bar are byte-identical; every bottom-anchored control moves to the lane. allowedRoutes is empty: this container reports no inset, so no route may drift. Instrument: npm run qa:gesture (CDP-emulated 24px bar at 412x819).
